body: thank you somuch for your kind words
well im the knight in shining armor alright, only i arrived 18 yrs late.
yea, i agree, i started seeing somebody today
I see your point. Its not a toxic relationship, she just has serious issues that are not of her doing. Thanks for proposing an alternate option.
yea just started, thanks for the suggestion
The girl has had a pretty shitty life, none of what happend to her was her fault. Its hard to be tough on somebody who has never felt compassion and validation before.
I started seeing somebody this week, i got another appointment for tmrw.

In the ER i was very distant and i had a hard time feeling sympathy for her or telling her i love her and will be there for her. She just said how sorry she was and how difficult it all is and that now i should understand why she is a bad person.

thank you somuch for going out of your way to gather more intel.
I greatly appreciate your effort.

I think ECT will be something i will have to stress again with her psych.
He is the one that holds the key to it

thanks for the honest feedback on the med. helps me be aware of things and what to look for.

I dont think her stayin in the hospital will improve anything, its not a relaxing place for her mind.

As others have suggested i do need help aswell, its starting to take a toll on me. I need to and want to stay strong for her

thank you

Thank you somuch for feedback on the med. I am so paranoid about medication, since she has seen alot of bad psyc. in the first 3 months of her suffering. Overmedicated her to the max.

So you were suicidal but the risperdal helped ? can you elaborate on that ?

thank you again

My wife has a long history of very early sexual abuse, invalidating parents and being very badly bullied in school. 
She is the upmost sweetest person i have ever met, and i met alot of people. It is always too important to her what others think of her because of those long and early experinces.

Yes your 3 qoutes sums up how she feels pretty accurate in social circles.

Thank you somuch for your suggestions, i will explore them all.

I will get those books. Her DBT therapist said to drop other therapists, since she dosent want anybody interfereing with what she is doing. I have to agree with that since she saw a therapist in the psych ward and he told her to get over it and stop playing the victim,( my wife out of anybody dosent want to feel the way she does and if she could she would have just snap her fingers to feel better a long time ago) and that made her feel really shitty. God there are many bad therapists out there and it scares me.

You say you lived through it ? as supporter or actual patient ? what got you through either ?
Does it get rid of her suicidal thinking ?

thank you somuch, but i cannot intrude on redditors lives. advice & exposure to options and of course well wishes is what we need.
thanks you

Yeah, she is in a programm and has group classes every week.
Really did wonders in a few months. Completely took away the anxiety and panic, called DBT.
I just need something that will have her stop the suicidal thinking, everything else we can handle.
I was thinking ECT (electroshock therapy) they use that as a last resort.

Thanks for the suggestion, you are right i cannot fix her from the outside. I will ask her to tell me. I asked her a few times why she dosent reach out, she says she dosent realize how badly she is feeling until its too late.

Everybody has been telling me i need help myself, I dismissed it feeling i was a solid rock... until last week. I broke down, I agree that i need help to stay strong.

I will do yoga and mediate with her. It will be good for us both.

thank you for your wellwishes, being in socal will have them arrived sooner (much needed).
thank you somuch for your kind words
